from itertools import combinations

def f(p):

def f(p):

from fractions import Fraction
from math import comb

def f(p):
    n = p['n']; k = p['k']
    # prior 1/n per door; likelihood of opening k goats
    w1 = Fraction(1, n)  # car behind door 1: all opened are goats
    wo = Fraction(n - 1, n) * Fraction(comb(n - 2, k), comb(n - 1, k))
    post_other = wo / (w1 + wo)
    remaining = n - 1 - k
    P = post_other * Fraction(1, remaining)
    return P.numerator + P.denominator
